clips.hook: The gold AK he can't afford
clips.title: Dom maxed out an AK in GTA 6, found the gold finish… and didn't have the cash
clips.caption: Fully upgraded AK, gold finish on screen, not enough money in the pocket 💰
clips.voice_intro: Dom is deep in the weapon customization menu, piling every upgrade onto one rifle.
clips.voice_outro: Finding the gold finish and not having the cash is peak GTA. That rifle just became his whole reason to grind tonight.

clips.title: Dom swore his money was clean in GTA 6… it did not go well
clips.caption: Swore the cash was clean. The receipts conversation went downhill fast 😬
clips.voice_intro: Someone wants to know where Dom's cash came from, and he has an answer ready.
clips.voice_outro: Claiming you won it at the Botanica is a bold alibi. Nobody on that street bought it, and neither did I.
